structured.answer: The page says to open the account at פסגות and buy "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)", number 5139282. Putting in 500 ₪ a month for 10 years plus 10,000 ₪ at the start adds up to 70,000 ₪, and the page says I'd be left with about 86,492 ₪ after costs. I'd ask my son before doing anything.

stuck.why: It starts with מדד and English letters (S&P 500, MSCI). I nearly decided it wasn't for me.

stuck.where: Screen 1, the four boxes with sliders
stuck.why: The page had already filled in the numbers, including 7% a year. I couldn't tell if that 7% is promised or just a guess.

stuck.where: Screen 2, two columns side by side
stuck.why: I didn't know where to start: the account on the right or the fund on the left.
Red minus amounts and English fund names. I got anxious and tired and stopped.

Opens with מדד and English letters. Someone like me feels it isn't for her
